title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job Title: Principal Software Engineer, AI 

Location : Remote - US 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY 

At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.

This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

- Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.

- Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.

- Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

- Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.

- Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.

- Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.

This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.

This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.

THE TEAM 

The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.

The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.

THE SKILL SET 

- Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.

- Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.

- Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.

- Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.

- A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.

- Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).

- Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.

- Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.

title: Network Developer
description:
Senior Network Developer 

About Share 

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role 

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do 

- Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

- Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

- Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

- Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

- Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

- Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

- Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

- Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate 

- 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

- Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

- Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

- Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

- You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

- You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

- AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

- You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

- A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have 

- Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

- Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

- Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

- 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

- Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

- Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

- DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits 

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

title: AI engineer (AI & GenAI) - People Domain (f/m/d)
description:
Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un poste en CDI, nous recrutons un.e AI engineer (f/m/d) , basé-e à Paris.

🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe People Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer l'expérience de nos 100 000 collaborateurs par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Face à la fragmentation de l'écosystème RH dans plus de 70 pays, notre ambition est de construire une couche de simplification en s’appuyant sur les nouvelles solutions que proposent l’IA. Il s'agit d'une couche d'intelligence centralisée et agnostique des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.

Dans ce cadre, nous développons DaiLY , notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable, sourcée à partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.

Déjà déployé avec succès en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage à l'échelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des évaluations, amélioration continue de nos modèles et de leurs qualités et déploiement et intégration d’agents autonomes RH. 

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e " Builder " : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

🎯 VOTRE MISSION

Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers RH en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.

Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au sein d'un collectif dédié , en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d'architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.

Vous aurez notamment un rôle clé dans l'évolution de DaiLY : passer d'un modèle de simple consultation (Q&A) à un véritable système agentique transactionnel capable de déclencher des actions concrètes (ex : poser des congés dans Workday, s'inscrire à des formations via Decathlon University).

🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES 

- Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités

- Participer à l'extension des capacités de DaiLY vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).

- Implémenter des stratégies avancées de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les règles spécifiques au domaine RH.

- Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.

- Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps)

- Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).

- Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.

- Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).

- Coder des évaluateurs automatiques basés sur des golden datasets pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.

- Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.

- Sécurité, Cloisonnement & Déploiement International

- Access Management (ACLs) : Implémenter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d'accès au niveau de l'indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu'un collaborateur n'accède strictement qu'aux documents RH de son périmètre.

- Isolation & Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon.

- Support Multilingue : Contribuer à l'architecture d'internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l'embedding et l'inférence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversité de langues.

- Produit & Impact Business

- Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de DaiLY.

- Traduire, avec l'appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux métier en comportements de modèles et en métriques de succès.

🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE

Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d’une première expérience. 

- Expérience : Profil confirmé justifiant de plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orienté IA. Vous justifiez également d'au moins une expérience concrète et réussie de mise en production d'un système GenAI ou agentique.

- Stack Technique : Solide maîtrise de Python, de l'écosystème GCP / Vertex AI, et des frameworks d'orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ADK).

- Expertise LLM & Agentique : Solide maîtrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avancée de métadonnées), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte/mémoire.

- Qualité & Évaluation : Capacité à diagnostiquer une réponse incorrecte (problème de modèle, de retrieval ou de données) et appétence pour l'observabilité applicative (SQL / BigQuery / MLflow).

- Langues : Français courant obligatoire & anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).

Les plus : 

- Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.

- Expérience de traitement multimodal de documents ou dans des écosystèmes SIRH (ex: Workday).

- Compréhension technique des enjeux de sécurité (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqués aux LLMs.

- Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d'APIs.

🎁 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS

- L'opportunité de développer un produit d'IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien de 100 000 collaborateurs.

- Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud / Vertex AI / Databricks).

- Une politique de télétravail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux à Paris - Canal de l’Ourcq).

- Une culture du delivery axée sur l'autonomie, l'intelligence collective et la montée en compétences (accompagnement par un Lead, certifications, formations).

- Des avantages attractifs (primes mensuelles/trimestrielles, actionnariat salarié).

- Une ambiance résolument tournée vers le sport (nombreuses corpos, tests produits, pauses déjeuner sportives ou non, …)

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

title: Framework Software Engineer
description:
At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. 

Position Summary 

As a Software Engineer on the Framework team, you will work on complex development challenges, participate in technical design within your area, and play a meaningful role in shaping how we build and scale the systems that power ExtraHop's core products. You will work closely with cross-functional partners in Engineering, Product, and Security to deliver customer-facing features that enable detection, visibility, and automation at scale. This role is ideal for an engineer who brings technical depth, exercises sound judgment independently, and is motivated to grow their impact through excellent engineering and active collaboration.

Our team builds high-performance network detection and monitoring systems that operate at scale across increasingly complex protocols and data volumes. Our services and features are written primarily in C and C++ with a focus on security, scalability, stability, and reliability. Our team is focussed on enhancing, maintaining and optimizing core components of the system and functional areas related to protocol parsing, metrics publishing, continuous packet capture and Time Series DB. 

This role focuses on designing and optimizing these core systems with an emphasis on performance, reliability and deep protocol awareness. You will work on next generation initiatives including scaling and performance improvement efforts, evolution of our data storage architecture (custom to open-source based) and early steps towards a cloud enabled model. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services for ExtraHop's core Framework systems, taking ownership of moderately complex to complex features with limited guidance.

- Work across networking layers to implement and enhance protocol support

- Participate actively in technical design discussions, contribute to architecture decisions within your team, and author clear technical documentation for your work.

- Engage fully in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and retrospectives; hold a high bar for code quality and test coverage.

- Collaborate with Product and cross-functional engineering partners such as platform , infrastructure and cloud teams to translate business requirements into well-scoped, scalable engineering solutions.

- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve production and performance issues independently; conduct root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures.

- Contribute to platform modernization efforts and help evaluate and adopt new technologies or frameworks in partnership with senior and principal engineers.

- Participate in on-call rotations and improve system observability, reliability and operational readiness. 

Required Qualifications 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, STEM, or a related field requiring systematic and analytical thinking.

- 4+ years of professional experience designing and delivering production software.

- Strong expertise in C and C++ and other languages such as Go and Python.

- Experience developing on Linux Systems (multi threading, memory management, IPC etc)

- Proven ability to build and maintain performance critical systems. 

- Proven ability to debug complex issues (eg. using gdb, coredumps, performance tools)

- Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, packet processing etc)

- Strong command of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles, with the ability to decompose complex problems into clear, actionable engineering tasks.

- Self-starter who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal oversight.

- Excellent collaborator and communicator with a growth mindset and customer-first orientation.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications 

- Experience with network protocols (eg. HTTP, SMB, Kerberos, TLS, Microsoft protocols or similar)

- Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred) or distributed systems

- Experience with observability, on-call practices and production systems

- Scripting experience (Python or similar)

The salary range for this role is $145,000 - $160,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP 

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES 

Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. 

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. 

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. 

BENEFITS 

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

- Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

- Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

- Educational Reimbursement

- Pet Insurance (US Only)

- Parental Leave (US Only)

- Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

title: Senior/Staff ML Scientist - Bidding & Optimization (f/m/d)
description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones , connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem.

Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding 

The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users .

The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning . Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The stack is optimized for high throughput: PyTorch for training deep learning and RL models, distributed architectures for large-scale Bayesian inference, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: 

- PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading.

- You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users.

- Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints.

- Mastering high-dimensional data at scale. Large-scale Bayesian inference and handling sparse, high-dimensional advertising data are core to your work. You are strongly proficient in Python and related stacks, and know exactly how to architect scalable data pipelines to feed real-time optimization models.

- Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. 

What’s in It for You? 

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
description:
Cardog | Toronto, Canada or REMOTE | Full-time
https://cardog.app/careers We're the system of record for the Canadian vehicle: raw automotive data turned into facts that can be checked. Our open-source VIN decoder sits underneath a government vehicle registry. Some of what's interesting: - A government registry, a manufacturer's own filing, a listing site and an insurance record will describe the same truck four different ways, and nothing in any of those files says they're the same truck. Reconciling that, for every vehicle in the country, in a way that holds up when a regulator asks how you know, is most of the data work. - Seventeen characters on a door frame encode manufacturer, plant, model year and build attributes — badly, inconsistently, and differently per manufacturer. Public reference data covers some of it. The rest gets worked out from filings, recall documents, and patterns inferred across millions of vehicles. - We read vehicles directly over OBD-II now. Forty modules answered on a recent Hyundai, each reporting its own part number and installed software version. Nothing downstream of the VIN moves when a module is reflashed, so no registration, history report or dealer system knows what software is actually in a car. Hiring: VIN Decode Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Founding Engineer (dealer platform). TypeScript, Postgres, Cloudflare Workers. Full descriptions and apply: https://cardog.app/careers

title: Senior ICT System Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle als ICT System Engineer Als erfahrener ICT System Engineer bist du ein essenzieller Teil unseres Teams. Du planst, realisierst und optimierst moderne ICT-Plattformen und stellst deren sicheren, stabilen und leistungsfähigen Betrieb sicher. Mit deinem technischen Know-how, deinem Blick für das Gesamtsystem und deiner lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise entwickelst du nachhaltige Infrastrukturlösungen für unsere Kunden. 

Deine Aufgaben - Du designst, implementierst und betreibst komplexe System- und Plattformarchitekturen in On-Premises-, Cloud- und hybriden Umgebungen.
- Du automatisierst Provisionierung, Konfiguration und Betrieb von Infrastruktur mit Infrastructure-as-Code und Configuration-Management-Tools wie Terraform, Ansible oder PowerShell.
- Du entwickelst Skripte, Tools und Automatisierungen zur Standardisierung von Deployments, Betriebsprozessen und wiederkehrenden Engineering-Aufgaben.
- Du konzipierst und implementierst CI/CD-Pipelines für Infrastruktur-, Plattform- und Applikationskomponenten.
- Du betreibst und optimierst virtualisierte und containerisierte Umgebungen, beispielsweise mit VMware, Hyper-V, Docker und Kubernetes.
- Du integrierst Server-, Netzwerk-, Storage-, Identity- und Security-Komponenten zu stabilen und skalierbaren Gesamtsystemen.
- Du konzipierst technische Lösungen für Netzwerksegmentierung, DNS, Load Balancing, Reverse Proxies, Firewalls, VPN und sichere Systemkommunikation.
- Du implementierst Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Lösungen und nutzt Metriken, Logs und Traces zur Analyse komplexer Systemzustände.
- Du analysierst Performance-Probleme, Netzwerkfehler, Ressourcenengpässe und komplexe Incidents bis auf Betriebssystem-, Netzwerk- oder Applikationsebene.
- Du planst und realisierst Migrationen, Plattform-Upgrades, Systemablösungen und Cloud-Transformationen.
- Du entwickelst technische Standards und Referenzarchitekturen für wiederverwendbare und automatisierbare Plattformen.
- Du dokumentierst Architekturen, Konfigurationen, Abhängigkeiten, Betriebsprozesse und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar und praxisnah.
- Du arbeitest direkt mit Software Engineers, Security Engineers, Architekten und Kundenteams zusammen und übernimmst bei Bedarf die technische Führung innerhalb eines Projekts.

Was du mitbringst - Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung als System Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Rolle.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Server-Betriebssystem-Stack, beispielsweise Linux oder Windows Server.
- Fundiertes Verständnis von TCP/IP, Routing, DNS, HTTP(S), TLS, Firewalls, Load Balancing und grundlegenden Netzwerkarchitekturen.
- Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungsplattformen wie VMware vSphere, Hyper-V oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
- Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer Public-Cloud-Plattform wie Microsoft Azure, AWS oder Google Cloud.
- Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code, beispielsweise Terraform, sowie mit Konfigurationsautomatisierung über Ansible, PowerShell, Bash oder vergleichbare Technologien.
- Gute Scripting- oder Programmierkenntnisse, beispielsweise in PowerShell, Python, Bash oder einer vergleichbaren Sprache.
- Erfahrung mit Git-basierten Entwicklungs- und Deployment-Workflows.
- Verständnis moderner CI/CD-Prozesse und Erfahrung mit Plattformen wie GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps oder Jenkins.
- Erfahrung beim Aufbau, Betrieb und Troubleshooting produktiver ICT-Systeme mit hohen Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Sicherheit und Nachvollziehbarkeit.
- Fundiertes Verständnis von Identity & Access Management, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten, Secrets Management und grundlegenden Security-Prinzipien.
- Erfahrung mit Backup-, Restore- und Disaster-Recovery-Konzepten und deren technischer Umsetzung.
- Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Fehler systematisch einzugrenzen und Probleme über mehrere technische Schichten hinweg zu analysieren.
- Ein ausgeprägter Engineering-Mindset: Du automatisierst repetitive Arbeit, bevorzugst reproduzierbare Konfigurationen und behandelst Infrastruktur möglichst als Code.
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute technische Englischkenntnisse.

Nice-to-Haves - Tiefgehende Erfahrung mit Kubernetes und dem produktiven Betrieb containerisierter Plattformen.
- Erfahrung mit Kubernetes-Komponenten und -Ökosystemen wie Helm, Ingress Controller, Operators oder GitOps.
- Kenntnisse mit GitOps-Werkzeugen wie Argo CD oder Flux.
- Erfahrung mit Observability-Stacks wie Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Elastic Stack oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
- Erfahrung mit zentralem Log Management und SIEM-Plattformen.
- Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure, beispielsweise Entra ID, Azure Networking, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Monitor oder Azure Policy.
- Erfahrung mit Microsoft-365-, Active-Directory- oder Entra-ID-Integrationen.
- Erfahrung mit hybriden Identity-, Netzwerk- und Cloud-Architekturen.
- Kenntnisse im Bereich PKI, Zertifikatsmanagement und Secrets Management, beispielsweise mit HashiCorp Vault oder Cloud-nativen Key-Management-Systemen.
- Erfahrung mit API Gateways, Reverse Proxies und Webservern wie nginx, Traefik oder HAProxy.
- Kenntnisse im Bereich Software Development und Erfahrung beim Entwickeln kleiner interner Services, APIs oder Plattform-Tools.
- Erfahrung mit relationalen Datenbanken, Message Queues oder verteilten Systemen.
- Kenntnisse von Zero-Trust-, Hardening- und Security-Baseline-Konzepten.
- Erfahrung mit Hochverfügbarkeits-, Failover- und Disaster-Recovery-Architekturen.
- Erfahrung mit Immutable Infrastructure, automatisierten Image-Builds oder Configuration-as-Code.
- Erfahrung mit grossen Enterprise- oder Verwaltungsumgebungen mit komplexen Abhängigkeiten und erhöhten Anforderungen an Security, Governance und Compliance.
- Relevante Zertifizierungen, beispielsweise Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, Red Hat, VMware oder HashiCorp.

Das bieten wir dir - Eine spannende und vielseitige Arbeitsumgebung mit herausfordernden Projekten.
- Die Möglichkeit, Produkte zu gestalten, die echten Mehrwert für Unternehmen und Nutzer schaffen.
- Ein agiles Umfeld, das Innovation und Kreativität fördert.
- Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes und wachsendes Team, das gemeinsam vorwärtsgeht.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer - React
description:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.

Objective of the role 

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.

The team 

You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.

Responsibilites 

- 
Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features.

- 
Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP.

- 
Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure.

- 
Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products.

Requirements 

- 
5+ years frontend web development experience in TypeScript (React), CSS

- 
Demonstrated ability to create code that is easily comprehensible, maintainable, and testable.

- 
Eagerness to acquire new skills, delve into different technologies and programming languages, and a willingness to acknowledge areas where expertise may be lacking.

- 
Approach problem-solving thoughtfully, embracing curiosity and maintaining an open-minded perspective.

- 
You are comfortable incorporating AI-assisted development tools into your daily workflow and exercise strong engineering judgment when evaluating and refining their output.

- 
Knowledge of GraphQL.

- 
It would be a plus if you already had knowledge of relational and document-based databases (we use MongoDB and Postgres).

What we're looking for 

- 
You take responsibility over your own solutions and continuously improve them.

- 
You engage in proactive and efficient communication within our distributed work environment.

- 
You focus on building a great product.

- 
You excel at designing and creating coherent, user-centric interfaces that display complex information.

The interview process

- 
We start with a short call with HR or an Engineering Manager to align on the details of the job inquiry.

- 
There will be a longer discussion about your technical and professional experience and expectations with an Engineering Manager and another colleague.

- 
We’ll facilitate a technical interview with one or two engineers with some pair programming and technical discussion.

- 
You'll have a conversation with our VP of Product, Mark, and our VP of Engineering, Frank, to learn more about our product and engineering organization and discuss how your experience aligns with our goals.

- 
Last but not least, you will meet with our CEO, Ijad, and our VP of Finance & People team, Jess.

title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

- Du handelst eigeninitiativ, arbeitest strukturiert und hast Lust, die volle Verantwortung für eine geschäftskritische Infrastruktur zu übernehmen
- Du bringst verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

title: Head of Financial Systems Transformation
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity: 

Taxfix is going AI-first with full speed - and Finance at Taxfix is leading by example: We are looking for an expert professional who will be leading both the transformation of financial processes and implementation of AI in the Taxfix financial systems infrastructure. The focus is on improving our core operational finance processes further through automation and best-in-class practices - and to keep evolving them as AI reshapes what's possible both inside and outside our company and its AI-native platform.

This role demands subject matter expertise in finance, technology, and leadership across dialogues with senior leaders, product and technology experts, as well as incumbent finance team to ensure both planning and implementing of the financial systems infrastructure roadmap over time while ensuring resilience, compliance, cost effectiveness, and scalability.

Your impact will be visible across the firm including the most senior stakeholders. You'll define and own the roadmap end-to-end, from architecture decisions and change, to hands-on ERP configurations and design decisions, on to bespoke additions and refinements to all financial systems, while further embedding automation and AI into how financial systems and the Finance team operate at Taxfix. As part of this transformation you will lead a dedicated and highly motivated team.

This is in essence an architectural role where you are the finance team’s anchor co-evolving the a financial system total that meets growth in product complexity, R&D and infrastructure development, as well as strategic ambition. As such, the ability to sketch out a finance roadmap and implementation game-plan amidst such strategic context and growth ambition is key. This is paired with senior stakeholder management and delivering implementable projects with the day-to-day team.

The ideal candidate has a double spike amidst this context: historically a finance professional by training and with first-hand expertise across all core finance processes (order-to-cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay), followed by years of hands-on finance systems work, automation and ERP experience blending more recently into AI, advanced analytics, business process workflows, and finance transformation projects. Your accounting literacy and sensitivity for audit-ready data and systems are matched by your technical depth.

the “other way round” works just as well: a data engineer or leader with a more technological background by training, historically, to meanwhile having transitioned into complex business and finance projects. As such, core finance processes including treasury and financial planning systems with reconciliation procedures are ingrained in your way of thinking and working, and by now you have been responsible for financial systems for years in your current role. You have been delivering results across financial system builds utilizing Precoro, Netsuite, Pigment, Chargebee and Abillify or similar, as well as driven wider best practices across accounting and treasury system transformations, all of which are complemented by more advanced developments of the last 2-3 years around AI workflows, vibe coding, business process and systems transformation put to work.

All of these render you a “builder” of the near future at Taxfix: a leader across topic and strategic dialogues for finance with company leadership internally and with strategic partners delivering financial technology to Taxfix externally.

Your responsibilities: 

- Map the current finance systems landscape across all Taxfix countries, identify improvement areas, and design the target architecture - owning integration patterns, data flows, and system boundaries across the full stack

- Drive the transformation of core finance processes through AI & automation and integration of best-in-class tooling across our systems spanning revenue recognition, accounting, treasury, and billing - from vendor selection through to go-live

- Make AI-powered automation a first-order priority, identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the controllership, and build up integrated core workflows - all of it not as an afterthought

- Continuously evaluate emerging AI and finance technology to ensure we're always running the best systems available - and staying at the forefront of technology and efficiency

- Define and sequence the multi-year finance transformation roadmap, balancing strategic ambition with pragmatic delivery, resilience, scalability and cost effectiveness when driving system design decisions and strategy

- Build a systems architecture that meets institutional-grade standards: robust controls, clean audit trails, and access governance expected of a mature, regulated business while navigating resource allocation for finance systems, source of truth data model, reconciliation paths, API connectivities, all of which in an international setting

- Co-own the control layers across finance systems incl. month-end close, revenue recognition, and multiple KPIs across all core finance processes

- Act as the primary liaison between Finance, Engineering, Product, and external partners - translating finance requirements into technical reality

- Lead system oversight and control across finance systems and strategically govern and document key processes - in particular monthly closing and chargebacks

- Ensure our client solutions and ecosystem of products are continuously supported by a financial infrastructure that can be considered best in-class with built-in audit readiness

Your profile: 

- 10+ years of relevant experience spanning finance operations and finance systems such as billing platforms or payments infrastructure, with deep ERP implementation and change expertise, and proven ownership of technological systems across high-stakes, time-sensitive change projects and workflow automation in multi-entity environments

- Proven experience integrating, migrating or upgrading ERP platforms with multiple vendors and strategic partners, e.g. with focus on subscription systems - you understand order-to-cash and revenue recognition at a system level, not just conceptually

- Track record owning AP/AR automation and treasury system implementations, including integration design

- Genuine fluency with AI in a finance context - you know how to separate hype from leverage and have built automation that stood the test of time

- Strong controllership knowledge across accounting close, consolidation, VAT, inter-company, and cash management

- Familiarity with governance and controls landscape, audit readiness and reporting standards of a scaled, institutionally mature organization

- Builder's instinct: you see fragility in a process and feel compelled to fix it - with systems, automation, or both

- Professional technical qualifications matter (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent standards in finance - or engineering); strong practical experience and demonstrated results delivery carry equal weight

Why this role?

- You'll own the full transformation arc - from assessing best-in-class against company requirements, designing and planning implementation projects and thereby continuously evolving finance in an AI-driven world where automation handles the repetitive work and every core process runs on best-in-class tooling. If that's the kind of work that gets you out of bed, let's talk.

Why Taxfix?

- A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

- Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

- A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

- Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

- 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

- A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

- Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

- Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

- Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

- Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.

Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture. 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Us 

Axiom is using zero-knowledge proofs to enable new types of verifiable and private software applications, starting with crypto and fintech. We are a small but incredibly strong team backed by the best investors in crypto . We’re looking for exceptional people who are excited to work on challenging and impactful problems in a fast-paced environment. Our office is in NYC and working in person in NY is our strong preference, but we're open to remote candidates as well.

We recently released OpenVM , a performant and modular zkVM framework built for customization and extensibility. OpenVM allows developers to verify the correct execution of arbitrary computer programs in a flexible and performant way. We are building ZK-enabled products using OpenVM and supporting teams building on OpenVM.

The Role 

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to help customers maximize the value they get out of OpenVM and the Axiom Proving API. You'll design compelling product demos, execute pilots, and work closely with teams across crypto and fintech to integrate ZK into their products with OpenVM. Beyond the sales process, you will own technical customer relationships by customizing OpenVM for user needs and ensuring successful product impact. You will also help shape our product roadmap by deeply understanding and communicating customer needs.

We are looking for someone with strong technical skills, the ability to work across the stack, and a product- and customer-first mindset. We also value the ability to make pragmatic design choices to solve customer problems while maintaining sustainable engineering practices.

Who you are 

- 
You have a strong track record of shipping full-stack products across frontend and backend using Python, Typescript, or comparable stacks.

- 
You are familiar with deploying applications using k8s and Terraform.

- 
You’re a clear communicator and relationship-builder. You're comfortable discussing complex technical topics with customers in all roles and levels.

- 
You thrive in ambiguous environments and have a strong bias towards action.

- 
You have an extremely strong work ethic.

Bonuses 

- 
You have experience selling a product or doing customer-facing work.

- 
You have experience with cryptography or blockchain engineering.

- 
You are proficient in Rust, C/C++, Go, or a similar backend language. 

Why join us 

- 
You’ll be an early employee with ownership to make key technical/product decisions.

- 
You’ll be working on groundbreaking tech that has the potential to be a key piece of infrastructure for the crypto industry and beyond.

- 
You’ll receive a competitive salary with equity.

- 
You will work with and receive mentorship from an exceptional team.

Our Team 

Our founders Yi Sun and Jonathan Wang met while studying math at Harvard and have been working on ZK since 2021. Together, they wrote some of the most performant ZK circuits for elliptic curve cryptography and Ethereum data reads before starting Axiom.

Before Axiom, Yi was a professor at UChicago Statistics and did a math PhD at MIT. He was previously an advisor for Gauntlet and worked at an HFT startup from inception to profitable trading. Jonathan published number theory research in top math journals and did a math PhD at UChicago.

The rest of our small but incredibly strong team includes alums of Applied Intuition, Coinbase, Color, Neon, Google, and Perplexity as well as math / CS PhDs and IMO / IPhO / Codeforces winners. We look forward to working with you!

title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.

What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

- Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

- Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

- ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

- Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale.

What you'll bring

We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience.

You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include:

- strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements)

- startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them)

- FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms)

What we value

We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building infrastructure that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable.

Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 

About the Job 

The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability.

What you'll do 

Architecture 

- 
Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors

- 
Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks

- 
Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines

- 
Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions

- 
Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. Likewise for Python.

Configuration & tooling 

- 
Design an easily extensible and testable module for deploying policies that can be reused across tasks and supports schema versioning for observations, so a deployed policy pins the exact version of the computations it was trained against

- 
Provide technical leadership on C++ and Python tooling (clang-tidy, sanitizers, static analysis, linting, typing, test setup)

- 
Work with our incoming simulation team to unify training, benchmarking and evaluation tooling across tasks, so adding a task doesn't mean forking tooling and infrastructure

What we're looking for 

Required 

- 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

- 
5+ years developing complex C++ systems, with deep knowledge of modern C++ (17 and onwards)

- 
Strong Python for tooling, configuration and simulation-side scripting

- 
Strong experience designing large, modular software systems that outlived their first use case

- 
High standards for software quality and long-term maintainability

Nice to have 

- 
Experience with behavior trees, state machines, or other task orchestration frameworks in production

- 
Experience working alongside learned controllers in a production stack - deployment, versioning, observation pipelines. No need to train them.

- 
Motion planning, geometric algorithms, or spatial data structures

- 
Feature-flagged deployments, staged rollouts, or long-lived platforms

This role is a great fit if… 

- 
You want to make systems work reliably in the real world, and enjoy thinking through the edge cases

- 
You'd rather our next behavior be a configuration than a dedicated piece of software

- 
You want the best idea to win regardless of who had it, and you'd rather be corrected by the numbers than agreed with

- 
You take a result end-to-end: when something needs to happen, you use or ask for whatever it takes, even outside your scope

- 
You're a software purist, but pragmatic — first make it work, then make it right, and cut corners consciously when it's the right call

When we released Holo4 on 28 September, we published every trajectory behind its public benchmark scores at trajectories.hcompany.ai . For OSWorld that's 369 desktop tasks, each run 3 times, with the steps, tokens and time of every attempt. This role builds and runs the evaluation framework that produces runs like these.

H builds computer-use agents and the models behind them. Developers use them through a managed API , and our forward deployed engineers take them into enterprise workflows.

What this team owns

The evaluation framework: orchestration, runtimes and observability. Researchers and forward deployed engineers bring the benchmarks, across web apps, desktop applications and the command line. Your job is to make the framework that runs them reliable, fast and cheap, and to make adding a new one quick. Research uses the results to choose checkpoints and decide whether a model ships. Product and the forward deployed engineers use them to measure agents on customer workflows. It carries roughly 50 benchmarks now. That number should be between 100 and 200 soon, and the framework has to keep up.

What you'd be doing

- Integration support for researchers and forward deployed engineers bringing in a benchmark, with a shorter path each time.

- Setting the standard for how a benchmark enters the framework, and building the checks that enforce it.

- Scheduling and observability, so cluster capacity isn't left idle while evaluation jobs queue.

- Reproducible results across trials, so a release decision rests on numbers that hold.

- Whatever stack a benchmark calls for. One week that's cluster tuning; the next it's a browser extension or desktop environments.

- Time with customers, from single developers to large companies, to find out what they want measured, then automating it so the results flow back into our harnesses and models.

The first few months

By 3 months you'll have helped researchers or forward deployed engineers integrate 5 benchmarks, and started fixing what slows the framework down. By 6 months one part of it is yours, for example scaling the runs, observability, or a group of related benchmarks, and a release will have gone out on your numbers. By 12 months you'll know the design and trade-offs of the whole evaluation system, and be the person the rest of H asks about evaluations.

Who you'd work with

Ceiran Chapman, our VP Engineering, is hiring for this role. You'd join the evaluation team. The people relying on your work day to day are H's researchers and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Likely a good fit if you 

- Have spent 5+ years in backend development, with production Python at the core, and use coding agents to go faster without letting quality drop.

- Have built test, QA or evaluation tooling that other teams depended on, and care whether a number is right.

- Have operated distributed systems on Kubernetes in a public cloud. AWS experience helps most.

- Have built and shipped systems end to end, including APIs (REST or GraphQL) and integrations with outside services.

- Know relational and non-relational databases, and message queues such as SQS, RabbitMQ or Kafka.

- Instrument what you build, with metrics, tracing and monitoring from the start.

Stronger still if you have 

- Measured LLM quality before, or built agents yourself.

- Packaged and run workloads in Docker and on virtual machines.

- Used Temporal, Dask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Grafana or Datadog.

- Automated web or desktop software with Playwright, Selenium or a browser extension you wrote.

- Set standards other engineers follow, through code review, design review or mentoring.

You do not need a background in machine learning. We'll work that out with you. If you match most of this but not all of it, apply anyway.

A 30 minute call with our Talent team, a 60 minute technical challenge, a 60 minute system design interview, and a 30 minute final conversation with Ceiran. About 3.5 hours in total.

Practicalities

Paris posting: Hybrid in Paris. That means 3 office days a week and a London trip about once every 4 to 6 weeks. There is a London posting for the same role. We offer a competitive package.
